property_summary: For every caller address caller and target address newOwner: if the caller is the current owner, then invoking setOwner(newOwner) MUST succeed (not revert); the mutant that requires msg.sender == address(0) causes such owner-invocations from any real owner address (non-zero) to revert, so the property holds for the reference for all inputs but fails for some fuzzed owner addresses on the mutant.
change_summary: Change the require in onlyOwner to require(msg.sender == address(0)) so only the zero address can call setOwner, making all external callers unable to set owner (reverting on calls).
